title: main: slow mode MUST on client conflicts with server-side enforcement
description: Chat.slowModeSeconds says 'each member MUST wait at least this many seconds between messages in this channel' but then says 'Enforced server-side; clients SHOULD display a countdown.' The MUST is on the member (client), but enforcement is server-side — a contradiction. Decision: rephrase as 'the server MUST reject messages sent within this interval; clients SHOULD display a countdown.'
close_reason: Replaced client-side 'each member MUST wait' with server-side 'server MUST reject with rateLimited'. Added the error code. Client countdown display remains SHOULD. No more contradiction between MUST on member and 'enforced server-side'.
